Based on the retrieved excerpts, the ISO 45001 clause that requires the organization to identify workers and other interested parties, understand their needs and expectations, and decide which of those become legal or other requirements it must meet is **clause 4.2**.

Clause 4.2 states: "Beyond workers, the organization must identify the other interested parties relevant to the OH&S system — regulators, unions, contractors, visitors, neighbours — and determine which of their needs and expectations become compliance obligations it chooses or is required to meet."
